headline: Indian Markets Mixed Amid Global Rate Worries and Weak IT Sentiment
why: Rising US Treasury yields impacting global sentiment
Concerns over Fed hiking rates above 5 percent
Surge in crude oil prices affecting domestic shares
Weakness in IT and Tata group heavyweights
whatHappening: Shares post longest weekly losing streak in six years
Investor sentiment hits 16-month low per AAII survey
Banks expect 5 trillion profit from FCNR(B) accounts
Air India CEO plans budget unit consolidation

stocksInNews.sources: Crude oil price worries and weekly losing streak
FCNR(B) notional profit projections for banks
IT sector drag on Nifty and Sensex
SBI report on banking sector FCNR gains

summary: Indian markets are experiencing a mixed trend as global headwinds like rising US yields and oil prices weigh on sentiment. The IT sector and Tata group stocks are under pressure, leading to a significant weekly losing streak. However, the banking sector shows resilience with positive profit outlooks from FCNR(B) holdings.
